name: agent-commit
description: Write commit messages with the coding agent you already use (Claude Code by default). One click per repository, so it always lands in the right repo, even in multi-root workspaces.

agentCommit.command.markdownDescription: Command that reads the prompt from stdin and prints only the commit message to stdout. Default: `claude -p`. Faster and cheaper: `claude -p --model haiku`. Any CLI that reads its prompt from stdin works.

agentCommit.language.markdownDescription: Language of the message. `auto` follows the language of the repository's recent commits (English if there are none). Or set one, e.g. `English`, `Portuguese (Brazil)`.

enumDescriptions: Mimic the style of the repository's recent commits

agentCommit.instructions.description: Extra instructions for the agent, e.g. "always include the ticket ID from the branch name".

agentCommit.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff size sent to the agent; the rest is truncated.

agentCommit.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the agent's answer.

agentCommit.notifyWhenUnstaged.description: Show a status bar note when nothing is staged and the message covers all changes.
